{"id":"project-LICHEN-worker6-2tdl","title":"accept_authenticated_schc_packet admits overheard unicast SCHC","description":"File: rust/lichen-schc/src/link.rs accept_authenticated_schc_packet

lichen-link::LinkLayer::receive_frame authenticates known-peer frames with no destination admission (unlike Python LinkLayer.receive _wire_is_for_local, which returns NOT_FOR_US before a receipt exists). AuthenticatedFragmentReceiver::receive_frame in this crate already requires frame.is_unicast_for(link). accept_authenticated_schc_packet does not inspect destination_mode/destination at all.

On LoRa everyone hears the air. An Extended unicast SCHC data frame destined to Charlie, overheard by Bob who has Alice's DIO context, therefore decompresses: is_current_for and accepts_authenticated_frame pass, counter > DIO floor passes, peer.decompress runs. Callers that then route/deliver the IPv6 (node/stack) can locally process or relay a frame that was not addressed to them, duplicating Charlie's copy. Broadcast (AddrMode::None) must remain admissible, matching Python _wire_is_for_local.

Fix: before decompress, require the authenticated destination to be this receiver: Extended dest == link.local_eui64(), None/broadcast allowed, Short only if the link has that short address, Elided only when the inner IPv6 dest is local or multicast. Reject others as InvalidPacket/InvalidPeerEvidence. new_value: {"notes":"2026-08-26 Phase-2 fix: reproduced Bob accepting Alice's authenticated SCHC frame addressed to Charlie (Ok(59)). accept_authenticated_schc_packet now rejects foreign Extended and all Short destinations before payload classification/decompression (LinkLayer has no installed local short-address state), admits local Extended and None broadcast, and validates Elided packets against the decoded inner IPv6 destination (local link-local, local native 0200::/8, or multicast only). Elided decode uses a bounded 1500-byte scratch buffer so rejected foreign traffic leaves caller output unchanged. Regression covers Extended foreign/local, broadcast, Short fail-closed, Elided link-local/native/multicast/foreign, one peer context, and output non-mutation. Green: focused regression; full lichen-schc --features std (71 unit, all integrations/vectors/docs); strict scoped Clippy std all-targets; no-default-features check; targeted rustfmt and diff check. Rust-only surface; no applicable C/Zephyr module and no Python changes (existing Python filtering was the oracle). No Phase-3 review."}
Reject overheard authenticated unicast SCHC before decompression; preserve broadcast and validated elided local/multicast admission with green Rust gates.
